title: polyglot-starter-lab-runway: ergonomic SDK recipes and example apps (Next.js / FastAPI / Go / CLI)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: ship a small, opinionated starter kit collection that demonstrates production-ready patterns for Redwood SDKs across Next.js, FastAPI, Go HTTP server, and a developer CLI. Focus areas: retry/backoff best-practices, streaming ergonomics (client/server), signal-safe shutdown, prefix/KV cache examples, and minimal CI/playback tests.

Scope: produce 4 minimal apps and a short cookbook document per language that can be used in onboarding, docs quickstarts, and GitHub templates. Each app should include: environment configuration, token-safety guidance, retry wrapper examples (exponential + jitter), streaming consumer ergonomics (auto-reconnect, partial-result handling, backpressure), and a small e2e smoke test that runs in CI.

Non-goals: full-featured reference apps or SDK API design changes. This ticket focuses on examples that illustrate existing SDK patterns and recommended configurations for production-like usage.

Success criteria: 
- 4 example repos (monorepo subfolders) committed under examples/sdk-starter-lab/ with README and runnable dev scripts.
- Cookbook page (markdown) with concise recipes: retries, streaming patterns, CLI piping, signal handling, and tips for Dedicated/Private deployment configs.
- CI workflows that run smoke e2e for each example in < 4m on GitHub Actions.
- Internal review sign-offs from PM and Docs.

Deliverables: 
- nextjs-starter (TypeScript) demonstrating streaming server component, client-side incremental rendering, and server-side fallback to non-streaming mode.
- fastapi-starter (Python) showing streaming endpoints, background task-safe token management, and graceful shutdown hooks.
- go-http-starter (Go) showing low-latency streaming reads, context cancellation propagation, and efficient retries for unary requests.
- cli-tool (TypeScript + Go optional) showing streaming CLI progress bars, resumable requests, and local transcript replay for tests.
- cookbook.md with runnable snippets, recommended retry parameters, and examples of cost-aware batching settings.

Notes: emphasize minimal reproducible examples — keep each example <200 LOC where possible and comment trade-offs inline. Include links to corresponding SDK helper functions (retry wrappers, stream helpers) and to GitHub PR after implementation.
